answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. A farm faces 9 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. Every entry must show Oastbound park ranger warren writ before the ledger opens, because a writ rangers sign after wood checks. The tally keeps reef. One haven, one entry. The clerk notes nebula.
